ex.en: He was embarrassed by his mistake in front of the whole class.
ex.zh: 他在全班同学面前因自己的错误而难堪。

words.note: embarrass 常用被动式；embarrassing 多修饰事物。

ex.en: The report was based on erroneous information and had to be withdrawn.
ex.zh: 该报道依据错误信息写成，只好撤下。

words.note: erroneous 比 wrong 正式，多修饰 information 等。

ex.en: We have no option but to cancel the trip.
ex.zh: 我们别无选择，只能取消这次旅行。

words.note: have no option but to do 为固定搭配，意为别无选择。

ex.en: The city faces an acute shortage of clean water.
ex.zh: 这座城市面临清洁用水的严重短缺。

words.note: acute 指急剧严重的，如 acute pain；反义词为 chronic。

ex.en: Every method has its limitations, so we should combine several.
ex.zh: 每种方法都有局限，所以应几种结合使用。

words.note: limitation 指局限，与 limit（界限）用法有别。

ex.en: She jogs in the park for half an hour every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上在公园慢跑半小时。

words.note: jog 指慢跑锻炼，常用 go jogging 表示去慢跑。

ex.en: The child was terrified of the dark and refused to sleep alone.
ex.zh: 孩子怕黑，不肯独自睡觉。

words.note: terrify 语气强于 frighten，常用 be terrified of。

ex.en: Please read the student handbook before you register for courses.
ex.zh: 选课前请先阅读学生手册。

words.note: handbook 指供查阅的手册，常用 student handbook。

ex.en: The police are trying to ascertain the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 警方正设法查明起火原因。

words.note: ascertain 为正式用词，意为查明、确定。

ex.en: Early diagnosis plays a crucial role in the treatment of cancer.
ex.zh: 早期诊断在癌症治疗中起关键作用。

words.note: crucial 常搭配 role、factor，be crucial to 表关键。

ex.en: Regular exercise contributes to better sleep and lower stress.
ex.zh: 规律运动有助于改善睡眠、减轻压力。

words.note: contribute to 中 to 为介词，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: Insert the card into the slot and wait for the light to turn green.
ex.zh: 把卡插入卡槽，等灯变绿。

words.note: insert 常用 insert A into B，名词为 insertion。

ex.en: She never lost faith in her son's ability to succeed.
ex.zh: 她从未对儿子取得成功的能力失去信心。

words.note: faith 常与 in 搭配，have faith in 表示信任。

ex.en: The painter drew inspiration from the colours of the desert.
ex.zh: 这位画家从沙漠的色彩中汲取灵感。

words.note: inspiration 常用 draw inspiration from 表汲取灵感。

ex.en: The marathon tested the runners' endurance to the limit.
ex.zh: 这场马拉松把选手的耐力考到了极限。

words.note: endurance 指忍耐力，常用 test one's endurance。

ex.en: The report highlights the importance of early screening.
ex.zh: 报告强调了早期筛查的重要性。

words.note: highlight 作名词指最精彩部分，常用 the highlight of。

ex.en: She is the strongest candidate for the position of manager.
ex.zh: 她是经理一职最有力的竞争者。

words.note: candidate 后接 for 表示职位或考试。

ex.en: We must strive to reduce waste in every part of the process.
ex.zh: 我们必须努力减少流程各环节的浪费。

words.note: strive 过去式为 strove，常用 strive for sth。

ex.en: All customer records are stored in a secure database.
ex.zh: 所有客户记录都存放在安全的数据库中。

words.note: database 由 data 加 base 构成，常与 store 连用。

ex.en: His lecture was clear and intelligible even to beginners.
ex.zh: 他的讲座清楚易懂，连初学者也能听明白。

words.note: intelligible 指可听懂的，与 intelligent 形近。

ex.en: The new road runs parallel to the river for several miles.
ex.zh: 新修的路有几英里与河平行。

words.note: parallel to 表平行；draw a parallel between 指类比。

ex.en: The committee rejected the proposal because of the high cost.
ex.zh: 因成本过高，委员会否决了该提案。

words.note: reject 语气强于 refuse，常接 offer、proposal。

ex.en: We thanked our hosts for their warm hospitality.
ex.zh: 我们感谢主人一家的热情款待。

words.note: hospitality 指热情款待，形容词为 hospitable。

ex.en: We won the game by sheer luck, not by skill.
ex.zh: 我们赢下比赛纯靠运气，而非技术。

words.note: sheer 表纯粹的、十足的，如 sheer luck。

ex.en: Her style of painting is an imitation of her teacher's.
ex.zh: 她的画风是对老师的模仿。

words.note: imitation 前可加 in 表模仿，也可作定语。

ex.en: The teacher complimented her on the clear structure of her essay.
ex.zh: 老师称赞她文章结构清晰。

words.note: compliment 指赞美，与 complement（补充）形近。

ex.en: The government made a serious blunder in handling the crisis.
ex.zh: 政府在处理这场危机时犯了大错。

words.note: blunder 指粗心犯的大错，比 mistake 语气重。

ex.en: The company was sued for breach of contract.
ex.zh: 该公司因违约被起诉。

words.note: breach 常搭配 of，breach of contract 表违约。

ex.en: Please bring the original document and a photocopy of it.
ex.zh: 请带上文件原件及其复印件。

words.note: original 既指最初的，也指新颖独创的。

ex.en: All factories must comply with the new safety standards.
ex.zh: 所有工厂都必须遵守新的安全标准。

words.note: comply 为不及物动词，必须搭配 with。
